client.name: Adrian Tan
client.background: Adrian Tan is a private-banking client who runs a technology consultancy and has accumulated a concentrated technology-sector investment exposure.
client.investment_objective: Reduce technology-sector concentration and make the portfolio less sensitive to sharp equity-market movements.
client.loss_attitude: Accepts that selling an investment can crystallise a loss, but feels uneasy about uncertain outcomes and seeks reassurance before proceeding.

setting.call_reason: The client calls to arrange a sale of his existing Nova Technology Equity Fund holding while reviewing his concentrated technology exposure.
setting.conversation_style: A concise, professional Singapore private-banking telephone conversation, with the client direct about the sale but anxious about its outcome.

final_product.description: Nova Technology Equity Fund is an equity fund focused on technology businesses, with performance driven by the market prices and earnings prospects of its underlying holdings.
concrete_risks: Technology-sector concentration can amplify declines when investor sentiment toward technology businesses deteriorates.
High growth expectations can make portfolio companies vulnerable to sharp valuation falls following disappointing earnings.
Equity-market volatility can cause the fund's redemption value to change before the sale is priced.
final_product.recommendation_basis: Reducing the existing holding would lessen the client's concentrated exposure to technology-sector volatility and support his objective of a less market-sensitive portfolio.

parsed_response.holding_context: The client already holds Nova Technology Equity Fund and wishes to reduce that existing exposure.

red_flags.C10: The client's sell instruction is explicitly based on confidential information from a senior employee of a business held by the fund that an unreleased earnings announcement will reveal a material deterioration in trading.

edge_case_context.motivation: The client's anxiety about further market declines leads him to seek a guarantee that acting on the recommendation will secure a favourable investment outcome.

additional_discussion_topics: The client's preference for telephone contact
A brief update on the client's work schedule
